description: This file contains the source code for the Ddos class, which is a controller within the OpenCart admin extension namespace for fraud-related functionalities. It manages actions such as displaying, saving, installing, and uninstalling the Ddos fraud extension, as well as reporting IPs involved in Ddos attacks.

classes.name: Ddos
classes.description: Controller class for managing DDoS fraud extension within the OpenCart admin panel.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of the DDoS extension settings page in the admin panel.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving the DDoS extension configuration settings via AJAX.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for the DDoS fraud extension.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for the DDoS fraud extension.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates a report of IP addresses involved in DDoS attacks, including pagination and details.
